label: Sticker Sheet
description: A die-cut sticker set built around one motif — the single most-printed thing people make with these models. Flat vinyl-ready colour, thick cut borders, and a subject family drawn per sheet.
prefix: A die-cut vinyl sticker sheet design, several related stickers arranged on one page
suffix: each sticker sitting on its own thick white cut border with a soft drop shadow, flat spot colour ready for vinyl, transparent background between them, consistent line weight across the whole sheet
negative: photorealistic, gradients, busy background, watermark, signature, text artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers
